title: Quadratic trade rigidity and cubic orientation in conic matching quotients
description: This preprint classifies full projective matching orbits from an intrinsic two-valued quadratic trade. Exactly the B_3/F_7 and H_3/F_11 orbits survive; quadratic products recover their two unordered sheets, and the first signed tensor moment is a cubic that orients them. It also proves the sharp fixed-line carrier boundary, quotient ranks 3, 6, and 10, and the self-associated Gorenstein consequences, with replayable computational evidence and a formal companion.
